notes.title: OPEN DEMO VERSION
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973892/0ccf557df02e78c553f39b6063cd051293a72cb3.png

Demo version
As part of the demo version, all players will be able to go up to the 5th chapter and see the beginning of the storyline. The total passage of the Demo version is from 15 to 20 minutes.

Patch 0.8
Patch number 0.8 will become available, both in the Demo version and for testers of the main build of the game, then it is planned to work on update 0.9 for the main build of the game. You can find out about all the changes in the patch in the previous news.

Rebranding
For those who noticed, the game was previously called "HardCube 2" and was a simple and cute platformer, but due to certain life circumstances of the developer, as well as the lack of profitability of this project, it was decided to make a major change in the game, in addition to a simple visual rebranding , the game also suffered serious internal revisions.

notes.title: Patch Note 0.8
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973892/1c2328cea5f24b8fe1c8e3aab0933428f4958810.png

Steam Demo Festival
In February, on the 6th of this year, an update will be released under the number 0.8. Below is a list of changes. This patch is dedicated to the February Demo Festival on Steam.

We also want to inform you that along with the release of the update, public access for the Demo version will open.

• Added support for new version of URP
• Redesigned lighting
• Replaced the character with the final version
• Work has been done on management
• Added new VFX effects
• Fixed some camera triggers
• Added new save checkpoints on levels
• Added a character customization item to the main menu
вЂў Added a stub for the store to the main menu
• Completely redone 1 Biome

• Animation of the main character with the help of sounds

IN PROGRESS:

Add the game to your wishlist if you haven't already :)

notes.title: Roadmap 2023
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973892/d814edc8d24ddb0dc61d86fa2a1e4715051b250c.png

Since the game itself is an ambitious project, our team decided to make a roadmap with goals so that the community itself would express the need for certain mechanics.

Undoubtedly, our plans include long-term post-release support and the addition of new biomes, levels and mechanics, but we want to know how much players will be interested in this product.

About plans for 2023

The Lever Software team has a goal of releasing HardCube 2 in the second quarter of 2023. The first months of sales will show us the results from which we will build on.

If our team is satisfied with the performance, we will stick to the Roadmap shown above. Otherwise, we see no reason to support a product that is not interesting to anyone and will be forced to distribute to new projects.

Please note! The game will be released in a finished state and without Early Access! It will be a full-fledged playable product.

Release
The release of HardCube 2 is a milestone event for us after several years of hiatus. The release of this project is a kind of warm-up before we conquer new heights.

Our team has several vectors for the development of our studio for the sake of certain genres and settings. We want to try ourselves not only in the development of platform games with low poly graphics, but also in other settings and genres that are interesting to us. We don't want to label our studio as "Platform Creators".

Therefore, we want to appeal to our current and future audience:
Your activity on this project and its financial and analytical indicators will influence our choice of development vector in the current year. This may be long-term support for HardCube 2, the release of new DLC, and possibly a sequel, the development of the HardCube universe. Otherwise, we will put an end to this franchise and move on and try ourselves in new genres and settings. It all depends on YOU!
